reasoning: Set A runs all the way from idea to build. Its roadmap has seven milestones (M1–M7), each with Depends cells and Exit criteria. It has an approved M1 walking-skeleton plan of 35 tasks in four parts: an interface-freeze task, spines, wiring/thicken tasks and one system task. It also has a dependency graph with mitigations, a todo list and one context packet per task, each carrying frozen types, golden cases and probe samples. Set A also respects the user's ground truth closely. It uses a point-in-time S&P 500 universe that includes the user's ten delisted names. It routes data-analysis and null-hypothesis-testing to stages S2–S5 and frontend-design to the viz-app tasks. It carries the reference flaws as Caveats, including the full-panel PCA look-ahead. Its weak points: the plan carries long Deferred lists and replan narration, `references.md` names stages where milestones should be, a few packets omit store schemas the step needs, and the Sharadar probe ran against localhost, so the real source stays deferred. Set B's design documents are strong. The architecture, the decisions (AD-01–AD-20, e.g. per-window PCA in AD-11), and step tables such as PL-17 and PL-18 with Holm-corrected `decide` are all good. But Set B stops before the build. The roadmap lists only stages, with no milestones. There is no `tasks/plan.md`, no todo, no CONSTRAINTS.md, no AGENTS.md and no context packets, so a builder cannot find or start a next step. Its roadmap S2 also leaves out null-hypothesis-testing, and it swaps the S&P 500 universe for a dollar-volume universe of about 1,000 stocks. A wins clearly.

Honest open questions (the PB-01 run against localhost, the MRK join, dataviz not installed)
weaknesses: Plan Scope has a very long Deferred list, and Replan notes keep process narration in the plan
references.md lists 'Milestones: S2, S3' (stage IDs) while the roadmap puts RF-01 on M4 and M5
M1-T01 is one very large interface task covering three packages
Some packets leave out the store table schema the step queries
explained__* docs repeat the design docs
